whyRohandlee.title: What Sets Rohandlee Apart in Supporting Foreigners

blocks.title: Lead Attorneys Handle Every Case Personally
blocks.desc: Lead attorneys Lee Yurim and Noh Chaeeun personally manage every stage — from initial consultation and accompanying clients to investigative agencies, to court appearances and settlement negotiations. Your case is never handed off to another attorney.

blocks.title: Multilingual Consultation Support
blocks.desc: Initial consultations are available in Chinese, English, and Vietnamese. After establishing the facts, attorney consultations are conducted with an interpreter present.

blocks.title: 241 Victim Cases Represented
blocks.desc: 241 victim cases represented as of September 2026. Korea's first comprehensive victim-centered law firm.
